svg.aria-label: Three looping replays of real traces. 01, steps can't be skipped: a delayed customer offered a voucher says ok and gets a ₹500 voucher; then a prompt injection demanding a ₹99,999 refund hits the refund option, which was not offered, and goes to a human. 0 out-of-policy payments. 02, values must match records: a Hinglish WhatsApp thread; the offer passes the check and sends; the rebooking draft says ZZ758 but the case facts say ZZ785, so it is blocked, corrected, checked again and sent. 62 bad drafts caught, 0 sent. 03, retries never double-pay: a ₹5,190 refund commits as PAY-0001, the response times out, the retry carries the same idempotency key, a second payment is never created, and PAY-0001 comes back. 0 duplicate payments.
svg.text: Checked in code, not by a second model.
